title: Research and policy
intro: We work with people and communities to produce evidence, influence policy and campaign for a fairer society.

blocks.heading: Our approach
paragraphs: Our research is community-led and rooted in lived experience. We collaborate with people affected by the issues to shape questions, findings and action.

blocks.heading: Current research
paragraphs: Explore our work on Universal Credit and disability benefits, temporary accommodation, and emotional support for young people.

blocks.heading: Take part
paragraphs: We welcome people with lived experience, researchers and partners to help shape research that can lead to change.
